company</strong></h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Sanctuary is a US based real estate company that builds nature-led, wellness-centered communities. Our first 135-acre residential community in the Texas Hill Country is designed with:</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">🌱 Non-toxic materials</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">💧 Clean water and filtration systems</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">⚡ EMF-conscious design</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">🌿 135 acres of preserved land and eco-sensitive planning</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">🏗️ Masonry construction</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We are a global team (spread across 8 countries) of designers, architects, engineers, and dreamers building spaces that restore and inspire. For us, it's not just where people live - it's how they live.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Our vision is to bring Sanctuary to major cities around the world: healthy, sovereign communities that sit on the edges of every modern metropolis.<br /></p><h2><strong>The role</strong></h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We're looking for a Finance Operations Lead who owns the execution layer behind everything we build — draws, lender relationships, insurance, debt tracking, and cashflow visibility. You sit at the intersection of finance, construction, and operations, and you move between all three without losing a beat.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You're the person who builds the system before the chaos arrives. You catch problems before they escalate. You give leadership the real-time clarity they need to make capital decisions with confidence.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>Your day-to-day</strong></h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Capital &amp; Draw management</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own and manage the full draw cycle for all active development projects across multiple lenders</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Prepare, compile, and submit draw requests with complete supporting documentation — cost certifications, inspection reports, title updates, and lien waivers</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Coordinate with lenders, inspectors, and title companies to ensure timely review and funding of each draw</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Maintain a master draw schedule across the portfolio and proactively flag delays or funding risks</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Track draw disbursements against approved budgets and flag variances for review</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Review closing documents, title commitments, settlement statements, and HUDs to identify discrepancies, funding risks, or at-risk situations prior to closing</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Lender communication &amp; relationship management</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Serve as the primary point of contact for all lenders—managing all day-to-day communication and back-and-forth required to advance and receive draws</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Build strong, trust-based relationships with lender asset managers, construction monitors</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Navigate lender queries, information requests, and conditions professionally and efficiently</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Ensure all loan covenants, reporting requirements, and draw conditions are met on time</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Coordinate internally with project managers, contractors, and the development team to gather and verify draw documentation</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Insurance coordination</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own the full insurance lifecycle across all projects and entities - builder's risk, general liability, title, and other required coverages</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Proactively solicit and evaluate quotes from brokers; make recommendations and coordinate binding of coverage</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Manage premium payment schedules - ensure payments are made on time and reflected in project and company cashflow</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Maintain a live insurance register and ensure all coverage is lender-compliant at all times. Track renewal dates and initiate renewal processes ahead of expiry</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Interest &amp; debt service tracking</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Track interest accruals and payment schedules across all construction and development loans</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Reconcile interest statements from lenders against internal records and flag discrepancies</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Work with the finance team to ensure interest payments are reflected accurately in project cost projections and company cashflow</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Cashflow &amp; reporting</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Act as the operational bridge between construction and capital teams</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Produce weekly and monthly reporting on draw status, upcoming payments, and projected funding needs</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Work closely with the CEO/Head of Capital to provide forward-looking cashflow inputs for treasury planning</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Flag cashflow pinch points early and work cross-functionally to mitigate timing risks</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>You're probably a great fit if you have…</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">4–7 years of experience in real estate development finance, construction lending, or a related role</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Solid understanding of construction loan mechanics - draw procedures, lender requirements, inspection processes, and loan covenants.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience managing schedules and liaising with brokers and lenders on coverage compliance</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Strong financial literacy - comfortable reading loan agreements, reconciling interest statements, and building cashflow models</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Highly organised with a track record of managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Excellent communicator - able to manage lender relationships professionally and coordinate internally across finance, development, and legal teams</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Suite (Sheets, Docs, Drive, Gmail)  -  you build tools and trackers that others rely on</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">High attention to detail and ownership mentality - you catch things before they become problems and follow through until they are resolved</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Comfortable operating in ambiguity -
